Best estimate of the wall-clock time of the chair's first audible words (greeting). TV-anchored where TV evidence exists, else convention. See start_source.

As tv_open_cnbc_s for FOX Business (calibration -3.4 s).
Change of the TV-vs-caption offset from the first to the last 10 minutes of the presser (Internet Archive segments; CNBC, else FBC). Near 0 = caption timeline linear and uncut against live TV.
1 = FOX Business offsets disagree with CNBC by > 12 s and were excluded (FBC captions ran about 30 s later than CNBC from late 2022 to early 2025).
Internet Archive TV item pages (60 s caption segments), CNBC: V0 + delay - sched; differs from GDELT by about -14 s (calibrated on overlapping meetings).
As above, FOX Business.
